description: BARONS COURT STATION: From Monday 6 July until November, westbound trains will not call at Barons Court. Step-free routes from Liverpool Street to Kings Cross St Pancras and Euston (via Euston Square): For Kings Cross, take a Metropolitan line eastbound train (platform 1) to Aldgate. Stay on the train. After a few minutes, the train reverses and travels westbound: you can get off at Kings Cross step-free. Eastbound journeys from Kings Cross are step-free direct to Liverpool Street. 

For Euston, take a Metropolitan line eastbound train (platform 1) to Aldgate. Stay on the train. After a few minutes, the train reverses and travels westbound and you can get off at Euston Square step-free. It is then a 10 minute step-free walk via the street to Euston. Euston Square is step-free westbound only, so you cannot do the same journey in reverse to return to Liverpool Street. 

Mini ramps are available at Liverpool Street, Kings Cross and Euston Square. To request a mini ramp speak to a member of staff before you start your journey.

WATERLOO STATION: Although step-free access is available to/from the Bakerloo line southbound platform, the curved platform has large gaps between train and platform, has no manual boarding ramps, and is unsuitable for wheelchair users and those with pushchairs.

PIMLICO STATION: From Friday 9 October until late December, no down escalator. Please use the stairs. To avoid the stairs, or if you are travelling with luggage, buggies or small children, please use local bus services 2, 36, or 185 from Vauxhall Bridge Road, stop A for Victoria and stop D for Vauxhall. CANADA WATER STATION: Until Spring 2027, no step-free access between street and ticket hall level at this station. This is while we carry out lift replacement work. For step-free access to the Jubilee line, take bus 47 or 188 from stop B1 in the bus station to Bermondsey. For step-free access to the Windrush line, take any bus from stop B2, or bus 1 or 381 from stop C in the bus station to Surrey Quays. Alternatively, it is about an 800m journey to Surrey Quays at street level via Deal Porters Way. You will not be able to use the lift between the street and ticket hall to enter the station. Please plan ahead and allow more time for your journey
